limitations: Journal full text closed; full text, Supplementary methods and Table S2 taken from the open thesis (source 'thesis', Paper IV)

All proteomics mice received 0.2% cuprizone for 6 weeks; this shared exposure is represented by characteristics[disease], not by a separate treatment column (treatment = experimental arm fingolimod/placebo; fingolimod 1 mg/kg daily oral gavage from week 5)
Sampling time 6/7/9 week counted from cuprizone start (thesis text + Table S2 channel layout)
Developmental stage 'adult' inferred from age on arrival (five weeks) plus experiment duration; exact age at sampling not stated
Which two mice form each mini-pool is not stated; one mouse died during the study (47 analysed) and its group is not stated in the proteomics section
Reference pool treatment and sampling time are 'not applicable' (mixture of all arms and time points)
Alkylation reagent not stated (omitted); collision energy NCE 32% reported but not added as a column
Enzyme could not be verified from peptide C-termini because only a protein-level table is openly small enough to read
